sar.reason: R6: Shared device profile linking multiple compromised cardholders in coordinated fraud
sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, fraud operations detected coordinated unauthorized activity involving transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 (customer C13487) totaling $74.96. Graph analysis revealed that the device profile utilized for this authorization matches device fingerprints recorded across several distinct cardholders during the same period. The common device signature indicates an organized credential theft or card-not-present fraud operation. The card was blocked, connected cards placed under heightened monitoring, and this filing submitted under BSA requirements.

stop_reason: Shared origin confirmed by graph traversal and analyst review; all connected cards protected.
